title: Essential smallness of the pair henselization category
statement: For a commutative ring B and ideal J, let C be the full category of ring maps B to D with Spec(D) to Spec(B) etale [def-weil-etale-morphism] and the canonical map B/J to D/JD bijective, with all B-algebra maps as morphisms. Then C is essentially small in the universe of B.

proof.text:
An etale ring map is finitely presented, hence of finite type. The equivalence
between rings under `B` and commutative `B`-algebras restricts to a fully faithful functor
from this full subcategory to `FGAlgCat B`. Mathlib proves that the latter is essentially
small using quotients of polynomial rings on finitely many variables. Essential smallness
pulls back along the fully faithful functor; the quotient condition needs no extra argument.

lean.statement: theorem pair_henselization_essentiallySmall (B : Type u) [CommRing B] (J : Ideal B) : EssentiallySmall.{u} (ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory (fun C : Under (CommRingCat.of B) ↦ AlgebraicGeometry.Etale (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map C.hom) ∧ Function.Bijective (Ideal.quotientMap (J.map C.hom.hom) C.hom.hom (Ideal.le_comap_map))))
